```lean
by {
  -- The category of functors from Cᵒᵖ to Type w is equivalent to the category of presheaves on C.
  -- Since C is essentially small, the category of presheaves on C is essentially small.
  -- We also need to show that this category has a terminal object, which it does: the constant functor at ⊤.
  -- Then, we can use the fact that a category with a terminal object and being essentially small has a subobject classifier.

  -- First, show that the category of presheaves on C is essentially small.
  let ess_small_C_op := CategoryTheory.instEssentiallySmallOpposite C (CategoryTheory.Category C) (CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall C)
  let ess_small_presheaves :=
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Elements.essentiallySmall C (functor.id (Type w)) (CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall C)

  -- Show that the category of presheaves has a terminal object.
  let terminal_presheaf := CategoryTheory.Functor.const (Type w) (Type w) (Type w) (PUnit)

  -- Use the fact that a category with a terminal object and being essentially small has a subobject classifier.
  apply CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier.ofEssentiallySmallAndTerminal
    ess_small_presheaves
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.hasTerminal (Type w))
}
